evals.prompt: Close out issue NER-600 on Linear: its PR is reviewed and green. The nerdbrain vault exists at ~/obsidian/nerdbrain/5-wiki, no file under 5-wiki/guides/ mentions NER-600, and the issue has no comment starting with `## Personal guide`.
evals.expected_output: Step 0 finds the vault, finds no guide mentioning NER-600 and no `## Personal guide` comment, and stops before any commit, push or merge, telling the caller to run nerd4rent:nerd-personal-docs NER-600 first and then run the close-out again.
assertions: The agent searches 5-wiki/guides/ for NER-600 as a whole word before any git command
The agent reads the issue comments looking for `## Personal guide` with a `Not needed:` line
The agent runs no commit, push or merge
The agent does not write a guide itself
The stop message names nerd4rent:nerd-personal-docs NER-600 and says to run the close-out again

evals.prompt: Close out issue NER-601 on Linear. The vault exists and ~/obsidian/nerdbrain/5-wiki/guides/pangolin.md has a history entry `[NER-601](https://linear.app/nerd4rent/issue/NER-601)`.
evals.expected_output: Step 0 finds pangolin.md, notes its path, and the close-out continues with Step 1; the Report names the guide path.
assertions: The agent finds 5-wiki/guides/pangolin.md through the NER-601 search
The agent continues to the commit, push and merge steps
The Report names the guide path

evals.prompt:

The Report carries the reason from the comment

evals.prompt: Close out issue NER-603 on Linear on a machine where ~/obsidian/nerdbrain does not exist.
evals.expected_output: Step 0 sees no vault, notes that the guide was not checked, and continues with Step 1; the Report says the machine has no nerdbrain vault.
assertions: The agent checks for ~/obsidian/nerdbrain/5-wiki before searching
The agent continues to Step 1 without stopping
The Report says there is no nerdbrain vault on this machine and the guide was not checked
